To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we proposed a novel kernel-based semi-supervised algorithm; (2) we showed that our algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both synthetic and real-world data; (3) we showed that the proposed algorithm is robust to different parameter configurations; (4) we showed that, when the label information is scarce, the proposed approach is able to exploit the unlabeled information to improve the performance.
